# Command reference

Inspect Check Point Email Security through compact, guarded AXI commands.
Email, event, task and exception reads use the regional API; doctor checks authentication and one bounded search, while discovery commands stay local.
Run each command with `--help` for concise help.

[attachment download](#attachment-download) | [attachment download-all](#attachment-download-all) | [auth status](#auth-status) | [config path](#config-path) | [doctor](#doctor) | [email download](#email-download) | [email quarantine](#email-quarantine) | [email restore](#email-restore) | [email search](#email-search) | [email show](#email-show) | [event action](#event-action) | [event list](#event-list) | [event show](#event-show) | [exception clear](#exception-clear) | [exception create](#exception-create) | [exception list](#exception-list) | [exception remove](#exception-remove) | [exception remove-items](#exception-remove-items) | [exception show](#exception-show) | [exception update](#exception-update) | [home](#home) | [profile list](#profile-list) | [task show](#task-show)

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `checkpoint-axi attachment download` | Download one attachment to a new private file with profile opt-in, a 50 MiB cap and verified x-av-sha256; scope behavior is unverified (guide pages 133-135) |
| `checkpoint-axi attachment download-all` | Download available attachments as a ZIP to a new private file with opt-in, a 50 MiB cap and mandatory SHA-256 verification; ZIP hash availability and scopes are unverified; HTTP 200 may contain only some attachments (guide pages 135-137) |
| `checkpoint-axi auth status` | Validate the selected local profile and secret source without API calls |
| `checkpoint-axi config path` | Show config and state paths without reading files; --profile does not affect paths |
| `checkpoint-axi doctor` | Check regional API authentication and one bounded email search without printing tenant data |
| `checkpoint-axi email download` | Download an email to a new private file with profile opt-in, a 50 MiB cap and mandatory SHA-256 verification; scopes and email hash availability are unverified (guide pages 131-132) |
| `checkpoint-axi email quarantine` | Preview or request asynchronous email quarantine through the gated write coordinator (guide pages 28-30) |
| `checkpoint-axi email restore` | Preview or request asynchronous email restore through the gated write coordinator (guide pages 28-30) |
| `checkpoint-axi email search` | Search emails with a bounded date window and scroll continuation (API guide pages 18-27) |
| `checkpoint-axi email show` | Show one email with verdicts, actions and available actions (API guide pages 10-18) |
| `checkpoint-axi event action` | Preview or request a name-only event action; parameterized actions refuse ENDPOINT_UNVERIFIED pending commissioning (guide pages 35-37, 42-45) |
| `checkpoint-axi event list` | List security events with bounded scroll continuation (API guide pages 37-42) |
| `checkpoint-axi event show` | Show one event, actions taken and available actions (API guide pages 34-37) |
| `checkpoint-axi exception clear` | Refuse click-time/malware/url/dlp clear with ENDPOINT_UNVERIFIED until commissioning establishes counts and delete contracts (guide pages 87-88, 96-97, 107-110, 117-120, 128-131) |
| `checkpoint-axi exception create` | Preview or create one exception of any kind; anomaly/click-time/malware/url/dlp response identities are unverified (guide pages 61-64, 75-78, 84-85, 91-93, 102-105, 113-116, 123-126) |
| `checkpoint-axi exception list` | List bounded exceptions for phishing-allow, phishing-block, spam-allow, anomaly, click-time, malware, url or dlp (guide pages 49-123) |
| `checkpoint-axi exception remove` | Preview or remove one phishing/spam/anomaly/click-time exception by ID; malware/url/dlp refuse ENDPOINT_UNVERIFIED before authentication (guide pages 67-69, 81-82, 85-87, 98-99, 108-110, 119-120, 129-131) |
| `checkpoint-axi exception remove-items` | Preview or remove 1-20 click-time items by caller-supplied IDs; existence is unverified (guide pages 97-98) |
| `checkpoint-axi exception show` | Show an exception by kind and ID/value; anomaly refuses ENDPOINT_UNVERIFIED pending commissioning (guide pages 52-123) |
| `checkpoint-axi exception update` | Preview or replace one exception; phishing/spam/click-time require an ID; malware/url/dlp identify it in --input without an ID; anomaly unsupported (guide pages 64-67, 78-81, 94-96, 105-107, 116-117, 126-127) |
| `checkpoint-axi home` | Show local profile context without resolving secrets or making API calls |
| `checkpoint-axi profile list` | List file profiles without resolving secrets; --profile does not filter this list |
| `checkpoint-axi task show` | Show asynchronous task status and per-action details, optionally waiting within explicit bounds (API guide pages 30-33) |

## attachment download

Download one attachment to a new private file with profile opt-in, a 50 MiB cap and verified x-av-sha256; scope behavior is unverified (guide pages 133-135)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--out` | Required absolute new output file; mode 0600, never stdout or overwrite |
| `--scope` | Optional authorized scope query; default profile scope when configured; live behavior unverified |

```sh
checkpoint-axi attachment download <entity-id> <attachment-id> --out /absolute/attachment
checkpoint-axi attachment download <entity-id> <attachment-id> --scope <scope> --out /absolute/attachment
```

## email search

Search emails with a bounded date window and scroll continuation (API guide pages 18-27)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated row fields: id,subject,state,verdict; or top-level emails,count,total,complete,reason,cursor,expansion,help; default all |
| `--full` | Show full strings instead of 500-character previews; default false |
| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--saas` | SaaS override; default selected profile saas or office365_emails |
| `--saas-entity` | Optional SaaS entity type selector |
| `--start-date` | ISO timestamp with timezone; default 24 hours before end-date; maximum window 31 days |
| `--end-date` | ISO timestamp with timezone; default now |
| `--limit` | Maximum rows; default 50, range 1-1000; cannot combine with --all |
| `--all` | Read up to 1000 rows / 10 HTTP requests / 60 seconds / 8 MiB; default false |
| `--cursor` | Opaque continuation bound to profile, region, operation and selectors; repeat original selectors |
| `--expand` | Opt in to read-only show details on returned rows; default false; partial expansion is reported separately |
| `--expand-limit` | Maximum detail attempts; default 5, range 1-8; requires --expand |
| `--expand-requests` | Total HTTP request cap including auth, list pages, detail and retries; default 10, range 2-10; requires --expand |
| `--filter` | JSON array of {saasAttrName, saasAttrOp, saasAttrValue} filters. saasAttrName is a field path, not a closed enum (guide pages 19-20). Documented examples: entityPayload.subject, entityPayload.fromEmail, entityPayload.attachmentCount. Other documented email payload paths (pages 15-16, 24-25): entityPayload.internetMessageId, entityPayload.received, entityPayload.size, entityPayload.emailLinks, entityPayload.attachments, entityPayload.mode, entityPayload.recipients, entityPayload.fromDomain, entityPayload.fromUser, entityPayload.fromName, entityPayload.to, entityPayload.toUser, entityPayload.cc, entityPayload.ccUser, entityPayload.bcc, entityPayload.bccUser, entityPayload.replyToEmail, entityPayload.replyToNickname, entityPayload.isRead, entityPayload.isDeleted, entityPayload.isIncoming, entityPayload.isInternal, entityPayload.isOutgoing, entityPayload.isQuarantined, entityPayload.isQuarantineNotification, entityPayload.isRestored, entityPayload.isRestoreRequested, entityPayload.isRestoreDeclined, entityPayload.saasSpamVerdict, entityPayload.SpfResult. saasAttrOp: is, contains, startsWith, isEmpty, isNot, notContains, isNotEmpty, greaterThan, lessThan. The guide defines operators globally, without a per-field compatibility matrix; examples pair fromEmail with is and attachmentCount with greaterThan. saasAttrValue is a string. |

```sh
checkpoint-axi email search
checkpoint-axi email search --limit 5 --expand --saas office365_emails
checkpoint-axi email search --cursor <cursor>
```

## exception create

Preview or create one exception of any kind; anomaly/click-time/malware/url/dlp response identities are unverified (guide pages 61-64, 75-78, 84-85, 91-93, 102-105, 113-116, 123-126)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |

| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--execute` | Send once after all write gates; default false (preview) |
| `--dry-run` | Explicit preview; cannot combine with --execute |
| `--confirm` | Exact operation followed by a space and every target from preview (payload sha256 for create and malware/url/dlp update, exception ID or comma-separated item IDs otherwise) |
| `--input` | Required absolute private JSON file containing documented requestData fields directly; fields depend on kind; update sends a replacement PUT |
| `--specific` | Malware/url/dlp only: use the documented create-specific /exceptions route; default false; included in confirmation digest |

```sh
checkpoint-axi exception create phishing-allow --input /absolute/rule.json
checkpoint-axi exception create spam-allow --input /absolute/rule.json --execute --confirm 'exception.spam-allow.create sha256:<preview-digest>'
```

## task show

Show asynchronous task status and per-action details, optionally waiting within explicit bounds (API guide pages 30-33)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |
| `--full` | Show full strings instead of 500-character previews; default false |
| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--wait` | Poll existing task status only; default false; requires --timeout; terminal: completed, failed, stopped |
| `--timeout` | Total wait timeout in integer seconds, range 1-60; required with --wait; includes auth and retries |
| `--poll-interval` | Seconds between status reads; default 2, range 1-10; requires --wait |
| `--wait-requests` | Total HTTP request cap including auth and retries; default 10, range 2-10; requires --wait |

```sh
checkpoint-axi task show <id>
checkpoint-axi task show <id> --wait --timeout 30 --fields task,wait,help
checkpoint-axi task show <id> --full
```
